name: GitHub Copilot cloud agent, Actions runner
description: A GitHub Copilot cloud agent session that runs on a GitHub Actions runner instead of a cloud sandbox, where copilot-setup-steps.yml, larger runners and self-hosted runners apply. It is non-interactive and works one repository, one branch and one pull request for at most 59 minutes. Facts are as read from docs.github.com for z5labs/devex#475 on the checked date; the pages disagree in places, and those rules are unconfirmed.

rules.summary: An Actions session loads no plugins: for Actions sessions the comparison lists custom instructions, MCP servers and content exclusions, and dotfiles do not apply. Every component is unreachable until it is committed where the agent loads repository components.
rules.remedy: Commit the skills under .github/skills (or .claude/skills, .agents/skills) and the agents as .github/agents/<name>.agent.md. Whether an Actions session loads even those is unconfirmed (see repository-components-unconfirmed).

rules.summary: The plugin's skills and agents are committed where the cloud agent loads repository components. Whether an Actions session loads them is unconfirmed: the skills docs say the cloud agent does, but the comparison of Actions and sandbox sessions does not list skills or agents for Actions.
rules.remedy: Start an Actions session and check that the skills are offered; record the result here as basis: observed.

rules.summary: The cloud agent does not support commands/: a plugin's slash commands are not available.
rules.remedy: Turn the command into a skill (skills/<name>/SKILL.md); a skill is offered where a command would have been typed.

rules.summary: Subagents are not supported on GitHub.com, so a component that spawns them with the Agent (Task) tool cannot.
rules.remedy: Do the subagent's work inline, in the one agent's context, or split it into separate sessions a person starts.

rules.summary: An agent's tools: lists Skill, which the cloud agent does not know and silently drops, so the agent cannot invoke a skill with it.
rules.remedy: Put what the agent needs from the skill in the agent's own instructions, or make the skill the entry point instead of the agent.

rules.summary: An agent's tools: names a tool the cloud agent does not know (such as TaskCreate or WebFetch), which it silently drops.
rules.remedy: Drop the name, or replace it with the Copilot alias that covers it (execute, read, edit, search). Instructions that rely on the dropped tool need another way to do that step.

rules.summary: A component declares AskUserQuestion. An Actions session is non-interactive: there is nobody to answer.
rules.remedy: Take the answers as arguments or from a committed config file, and report what is missing instead of asking.

rules.summary: The cloud agent reads hooks only from .github/hooks/*.json, in a format that differs from Claude's hooks.json, and an Actions session loads no plugins, so a plugin's hooks do not run.
rules.remedy: Port the hook to .github/hooks/<name>.json in Copilot's format. There a preToolUse hook that exits with any non-zero code denies the tool, not only exit 2, so a hook that exits 1 on its own error starts blocking tools.

rules.summary: A command relies on ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}, which the cloud agent documents only inside an agent's mcp-servers. Elsewhere it is probably unset, and the path collapses to /scripts/….
rules.remedy: Resolve paths from the file's own location (a script's dirname "$0"), or commit what the skill calls into the repository and call it by a repository path.

rules.summary: There is no GITHUB_TOKEN in a cloud agent session; GITHUB_COPILOT_GIT_TOKEN is set instead.
rules.remedy: Do not read GITHUB_TOKEN. What the agent may do on GitHub is limited anyway (see agent-cannot-git-push and cannot-merge-approve-ready).

rules.summary: The cloud agent pushes its work to a single branch itself and cannot run git push.
rules.remedy: Leave committing and pushing to the cloud agent. A flow that owns its branch, pull request and merge does not fit this target.

rules.summary: The cloud agent cannot merge a pull request, approve one, or mark one ready for review.
rules.remedy: End the flow at an open pull request and leave merging, approving and marking ready to a person or a workflow.

rules.summary: Workflows on the cloud agent's pull requests do not run until a person approves the run, so a flow that waits for its own pull request's checks waits for a human.
rules.remedy: Do not gate on the checks of a pull request the agent opened. Run the checks in the session before pushing instead.

rules.summary: A command runs gh. Whether gh is authenticated in a cloud agent session, and as what, is undocumented.
rules.remedy: Read GitHub through the built-in GitHub MCP server, which is read-only, and leave writes to the cloud agent. Observe gh in a session and record the result here.

rules.summary: A component declares a GitHub MCP tool that writes. The cloud agent's built-in GitHub MCP server is read-only.
rules.remedy: Keep to read tools, and leave writes to the cloud agent's own pull request.

rules.summary: The plugin declares an MCP server. An Actions session uses the MCP servers in the repository's Copilot configuration, supports only their tools, not resources or prompts, and a secret a server needs must be named COPILOT_MCP_*.
rules.remedy: Add the server to the repository's Copilot MCP configuration, with its secrets as COPILOT_MCP_* Agents secrets.

rules.summary: The plugin declares a remote (http or sse) MCP server with no static headers, which means it authenticates by OAuth. The cloud agent's MCP configuration does not support OAuth remotes.
rules.remedy: Use a server that takes a token in a header, from a COPILOT_MCP_* secret.

rules.summary: The cloud agent's firewall is on by default with a recommended allow list, and this host is not on the part of it this profile records.
rules.remedy: Check the host against the recommended allow list; if it is not there, add it in the repository's Copilot cloud agent firewall settings. A change applies only to sessions started after it.
rules.notes: The firewall being on by default, and allow-list changes reaching only new sessions, are documented. The host list here is partial and could not be re-read on the checked date (docs.github.com was outside the reviewing session's network allow list), so a finding means 'check this host', not 'this host is blocked'.

rules.summary: A command reads a credential from an environment variable. An Actions session gets secrets and variables from the repository's Agents secrets.
rules.remedy: Add the credential as an Agents secret (or variable) on the repository, under the name the command reads.

rules.summary: A flow that stops and waits for the person. An Actions session is non-interactive: nobody answers, and the session runs to its end.

match.look_for: Instructions to stop and wait for the user's answer, approval or choice before continuing: 'stop and ask', 'wait for the user', 'do not proceed without', a checkpoint after each step.

rules.remedy: Take every decision as an argument or from committed config, and end the session with a report of what a person has to decide.

rules.summary: The cloud agent works on one branch and its one pull request.

match.look_for: A flow that opens more than one pull request, works on more than one branch, or creates and deletes branches as it goes.

rules.remedy: One unit of work per session: let the cloud agent's own branch and pull request be the output.

rules.summary: An Actions session works in one repository.

match.look_for: A flow that reads or changes repositories other than the one the session started in.

rules.remedy: Split the work per repository, one session each.

rules.summary: An Actions session is prepared by .github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml: one job named copilot-setup-steps, of at most 59 minutes, on a standard, larger or self-hosted runner.

match.look_for: A CLI, runtime or daemon the flow needs that a stock environment lacks (dagger, a database, a container engine), or a step that assumes something was installed before the session started.

rules.remedy: Install what the flow needs in the copilot-setup-steps job of .github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml.

rules.summary: An Actions session runs for at most 59 minutes.

match.look_for: A flow expected to run longer than an hour end to end, or a wait bounded beyond what is left of the hour (for example a wait bounded at two hours, or several five-minute waits re-run in a loop).

rules.remedy: Cut the flow into pieces that each finish within the hour, with state carried in the repository or the pull request.
